title: Haddock and roast marrow bulgur bowls

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or a plain staple: fish, vegetables, bulgur, oil, Greek yoghurt and spices.

supermarket.reason: Haddock fillets, marrow, bulgur and Greek yoghurt are all everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, bowls, a knife and a grater, and the techniques are simple roasting and soaking.

works.reason: The 2:1 water-to-bulgur ratio, 30 minutes total roasting at 220°C and 10 to 12 minutes for the haddock all give a sound dish for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is fair for peeling and cubing a marrow, cutting onions and making the sauce, and 32 minutes cook matches the 20 plus 12 in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast marrow with tomatoes and dill is a proper late-August dish, and the marrow makes up the bulk of the bowl.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, wholegrain bulgur, plenty of roast veg and a yoghurt sauce make a balanced lunch a family would eat.
